info.name: Havenly Addresses Board Feedback Questions API

description.content:
Havenly REST API powering the interior-design platform: users and profiles, addresses, design boards and board products, vendor product variants (catalog), attribute types, board feedback, and user opinions/likes. Responses use HAL+JSON (_links/_embedded) with page/limit pagination and zf-doctrine-querybuilder query filters. Authentication is OAuth2 (password grant) returning a Bearer token; payment testing in non-production uses Stripe test cards. Derived from Havenly public Postman API documentation at https://api-docs.havenly.com.
